title: Assessing a RISC-V Accelerator for Cross-Section Lookup in Chipyard
problem: Monte Carlo neutron transport simulations bottlenecked on cross-section lookups; Doppler broadening computations via Faddeeva function expensive in software
motivation: Design custom RISC-V accelerator to address cross-section lookup bottleneck; validate RISC-V for HPC through custom extension evaluation
method: Custom RISC-V accelerator integrated with RocketCore in Chipyard; pipelined design using Humlidek 8th-order rational approximation for Faddeeva function; performance comparison with software RISC-V and Intel Core i5 Tiger Lake-U
key_novelty: Custom RISC-V accelerator for neutron transport cross-section operations; demonstration of RISC-V accelerator potential in HPC
contributions: Custom RISC-V accelerator design for cross-section lookups
Similar gains over Intel Core i5 Tiger Lake-U
Chipyard integration demonstrating HPC accelerator design
limitations: Limited to single kernel (Faddeeva); operating frequency optimization not yet done; scalability to additional kernels unclear; no power/energy analysis
